text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today marks the end of our time at summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Geez… Youth sure is fleeting, huh? I can't believe camp is already over.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But this is no time to get sentimental. The Arima Kinen will be here before we know it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm going to use what I learned at camp to have the best race possible!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list: I was thinking… of taking the bus…
